body.p: Ichakichika lived with his grandmother. Then Ichakichika said to his grandmother: "I will go to the house of grandfather Tyrshako". Grandmother said to Ichakichika: "How will you take a foreign human's daughter?" But Ichakichika said: "I will simply take a look on how people court". Ichakichika went down to the crust boat.
